# Project Guidelines

This repository uses pnpm as the package manager. Run `pnpm install` to set up dependencies and `pnpm dev` to start the development server.

## Coding standards

We follow the standard style guide. Use functional components and hooks. Prefer named exports over default exports. Write unit tests for all new utilities.

## Commit conventions

Use conventional commits: feat, fix, chore, docs. Keep commits small and focused. Always run the linter before committing.

## Architecture

The application is organized into feature folders under src/. Shared utilities live in src/lib. The design system lives in packages/ui.

## Getting help

Reach out in the #engineering channel for questions. See the wiki for onboarding docs.
